title: Mimi's Cottage
meta_description: Across From Beach, Steps From Seaside- Mimi's Cottage by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Mimi’s Cottage by Royal Destinations Location: Seagrove Beach Address: 2615 East County Highway 30A Details: Mimi’s Cottage is a charming Old Seagrove bungalow that combines the character of a classic Florida beach cottage with thoughtfully updated interiors. Built in 1953 and still owned by the original family, the home holds generations of treasured beach memories while preserving the nostalgic coastal style that makes Old Seagrove so special. Offering approximately 1,906 square feet of living space, Mimi’s Cottage comfortably accommodates up to 12 guests with four sleeping rooms and three full baths. Location is one of the highlights of Mimi’s Cottage, with the Hickory Street Beach Access directly across 30A and Seaside approximately 0.1 mile away. Inside, original cottage charm is complemented by hardwood floors, a fully equipped kitchen, two dining areas, and plenty of sleeping accommodations for families traveling together. Whether your days are spent on the beach, biking along the Timpoochee Trail, or exploring nearby Seaside, Mimi’s Cottage offers a welcoming home base in the heart of 30A. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: Hickory Street Beach Access Directly Across 30A -Distance to Seaside: Approximately 0.1 Mile -Parking Spaces: (4) -Dining Accommodations: (2) Dining Tables -Coffee Maker Available: Keurig + Drip Coffee Maker -Historic Old Seagrove Cottage -Hardwood Floors Throughout -Fully Equipped Kitchen -Outdoor Gas Grill Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 12 4 Sleeping Rooms / 3 Baths First Floor: -Bedroom 1 (Bunk Room): (2) Twin/Twin Bunks with Shared Full Bath (Walk-In Shower) -Bedroom 2: Queen Bed with Shared Full Bath (Walk-In Shower) -Bedroom 3 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Bedroom 4: (2) Twin Beds with Private Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Living Room: (2) Twin Beds -Kitchen / Living Room / Dining Room -(2) Dining Tables -Laundry Room Please Note: *On-street parking is not permitted. *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
